name: spawn_child

test_list.description: A broader child resource scope fails before quota debit; a valid narrower child spends only its leased step/token budget and returns unused CPU, memory, step and token allowance on drop.

inputs.name: parent
inputs.description: Active parent frame owning capability and remaining quota.

inputs.name: child_scope
inputs.description: Requested child capability scope that must be a proven subset of its parent.

inputs.name: child_quota
inputs.description: Numeric and network policy allowance reserved from the parent while the child exists.

output_description: A child frame with an attenuated capability and a leased quota allocation, or a typed error without overdraw.
